title: Hit the Road Jack
hook: Why Hit the Road Jack feels like *being thrown out*

chords.name: F
chords.text: *F*: another step. No way back up.

chords.name: E
chords.text: *E major*: its G♯ is the door swinging shut.

chords.name: Am
chords.text: And you're out. *Then it happens again*.

question: Name another song that uses these four chords 👇
